items.name: providers
items.title: NocoBase AI Knowledge Base Providers
items.description: Application-owned service adapter, current DTOs, error and pagination normalization, and stale-safe resource hooks.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base. Import the service contract, provider, hooks, and types through index.ts. The source is application-owned and upgrades must be reviewed with a three-way merge.

items.name: components
items.title: NocoBase AI Knowledge Base Components
items.description: Application-owned controlled knowledge-base, document, upload, retrieval, and segment components with locale resources.
items.docs: Install providers first (remote shadcn resolves it recursively). Import controlled components through index.ts and register locales in the consuming application. The source is application-owned and upgrades use a three-way merge.

items.name: workspace
items.title: NocoBase AI Knowledge Base Workspace
items.description: Application-owned complete knowledge-base management, document, upload, retrieval, and nested segment workspace composition.
items.docs: Requires the enabled @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base runtime and the providers and components items. Compose the exported pages in application-owned routes; installation does not register routes or enable the plugin. Preserve application edits through a three-way merge on upgrade.
